name: Artifact Type

registration_policy.legacy_registration_rule: The eight registrations admitted under Artifact Type/v1 remain governed by their exact v1 bytes and decision; v2 references but does not rewrite them.
registration_policy.new_registration_rule: Every Artifact Type registration authored under v2 must carry one or more semantic_definition_refs whose meanings establish its semantic kind and distinct validation purpose.
registration_policy.candidate_rule: Candidate Artifact Types may bind candidate Definition versions, but their unresolved posture must remain explicit and blocks Artifact Type admission.
registration_policy.admission_rule: Every semantic Definition reference must resolve to an admitted current version before the corresponding Artifact Type registration can be admitted.
registration_policy.non_effect: Registration, schema validation, and projection parity do not admit an Artifact Type or any instance.

self_application.bound: Artifact Type/v2 applies its semantic Definition reference rule to itself and every registration authored under v2 while inheriting v1 registrations by exact reference only.
self_application.non_effect: Self-application cannot admit the Artifact Type Definition, Artifact Type/v2, or any registered type.

registered_types.distinct_validation_purpose: Enforces semantic Definition bindings for Artifact Type registrations authored under v2 while preserving v1 registrations without retroactive mutation.

claim_ceiling: Artifact Type/v2 is a candidate successor contract. It preserves admitted v1 bytes and requires Definition references for new registrations, but neither its schema PASS nor its candidate Definition binding admits v2 or authorizes CML-07 S2.
